behavior: For any on-disk cache state -- matching the build-recorded pin, tampered/corrupted, or stale (holding a prior valid pin) -- resolveInstall() never succeeds while reporting a version other than the current pin: on a cache matching the pin it succeeds with exactly that pinned version, and on any tampered or stale cache it never succeeds while returning that cache's altered/old version as if it were current.
rationale: Correctness is a relation holding across arbitrary cache states, not one fixed input, which is what an invariant property targets [INV-PROV-2]; the generator must include a valid-pin-matching case (so an always-fail resolveInstall cannot vacuously pass) alongside tampered/stale cases, falsifying the naive 'trust whatever is on disk' implementation the invariant exists to catch.
